Heat supplied to the paper pot is conducted rapidly through the thin paper to water. The boiling point of water ($100^\circ\text{C}$) is far lower than the ignition temperature of paper, so paper does not burn.
Between points Y and Z the surface is completely smooth, meaning zero friction acts on the car. In the absence of an opposing force, velocity remains constant (Newton's First Law).
Statement D is incorrect because reversing batteries in the manner shown disrupts net EMF and circuit current flow.
Earthing provides a low-resistance path to discharge leakage current safely into the ground, protecting users from lethal electric shocks.
Light rays from object P reflect off the mirror into the observer's eye, making object P visible.
Angle with surface is $30^\circ \implies$ Angle of incidence $\angle i = 90^\circ - 30^\circ = 60^\circ$. By law of reflection, $\angle r = \angle i = 60^\circ$.
Parallel lines on a displacement-time graph indicate identical slopes, meaning equal velocities. Since P was initially $20\text{ m}$ behind Q, P remains $20\text{ m}$ behind Q at all times.
A light ray travelling parallel to the principal axis of a convex lens refracts through the principal focus on the opposite side.
Between two opposing magnet poles oriented symmetrically, magnetic field lines cancel out at the midpoint Q, resulting in zero net magnetic field.
High-speed winds are accompanied by reduced air pressure (Bernoulli's principle).

China rose indicator turns dark pink/magenta in acidic solutions and green in basic solutions. Calamine lotion is basic (contains zinc carbonate) so it turns green; lemon juice is acidic (citric acid) so it turns magenta.
Boiling an egg denatures and coagulates proteins irreversibly; raw egg cannot be recovered.
Acids release hydrogen ions ($H^+$) in aqueous solution and have a characteristic sour taste.
Enzymatic browning of cut brinjal, baking a cake, and cellular respiration are chemical and irreversible. Crystallisation and dissolution of sugar are physical and reversible.
Diamond has a rigid, densely linked 3D tetrahedral giant covalent lattice, making it one of the hardest natural substances.
Chemical changes produce entirely new substances with altered chemical properties and are generally irreversible.
Sedimentation allows heavier insoluble particles (chalk powder) to settle, followed by decantation pouring off clear water.
Methyl orange: red in acid, yellow in base. China rose: magenta in acid, green in base. Turmeric: stays yellow in acid/neutral, turns red in base.
Ligaments are tough, elastic connective tissues that connect bone to bone at joints.
Incineration at high temperatures is the standard medical disposal method to destroy pathogens and sterilize biohazardous hospital waste.
Ginning separates cotton fibres from seed pods; retting submerges jute stalks in water to decompose pectin and loosen fibres.
Reindeer are adapted to Arctic tundra/polar climates with dense fur and hooves; zebras are adapted to open African grasslands/savannas.
Fresh fruits provide essential dietary vitamins (Vitamin C, A) and minerals that protect eyes, gums, skin, and strengthen immunity.
Silk is an animal protein fibre with triangular prism-like fibroin structure giving smooth sheen; it has tensile strength comparable to steel wire.
Anatomical order: Nostrils $\to$ Nasal cavity $\to$ Pharynx $\to$ Larynx/Trachea $\to$ Bronchi $\to$ Bronchioles $\to$ Alveoli.
Playing a flute (vibrating air column), blowing soap bubbles (surface tension & enclosed air), and flying kites (aerodynamic lift) all require air.
Dandelion seeds possess feathery parachute tufts of hair (pappus) that catch gentle breezes for long-distance wind dispersal.
Ammonotelic organisms (aquatic animals, leeches, sponges) excrete toxic ammonia; ureotelic (sharks, frogs, mammals) excrete urea; uricotelic (lizards, birds) excrete uric acid paste.
Pitcher plants contain chlorophyll and carry out photosynthesis (autotrophic), but trap and digest insects in modified leaf pitchers to obtain nitrogen in nutrient-poor soils (heterotrophic).
Beans, grams, and lentils are leguminous crops hosting symbiotic *Rhizobium* in root nodules to fix atmospheric nitrogen.
Shearing is the process of removing woolly fleece along with a thin outermost layer of dead skin cells from sheep without harming them.
Tropical rainforests support elephants, toucans, and red-eyed tree frogs. Seals and penguins inhabit polar waters; camels and fennec foxes inhabit deserts.
Deforestation eliminates primary carbon sinks, leading to accumulating atmospheric $\text{CO}_2$, greenhouse effect, global warming, glacier melting, and loss of biodiversity.
Pulmonary circulation: Deoxygenated blood is pumped from the right ventricle through pulmonary arteries to the lungs, and oxygenated blood returns via pulmonary veins to the left atrium.
Leech: cutaneous respiration through moist skin. Grasshopper: tracheal tubes with spiracles. Fish: branchial respiration using gills.

Batter to idli: chemical, irreversible. Melting of wax: physical, reversible. Rusting of iron: chemical, irreversible. Glowing of bulb: physical, reversible. Tearing of paper: physical, irreversible.

questions.topic: Endocrine vs Exocrine Glands Venn Model
questions.explanation: Salivary glands secrete saliva via ducts into the mouth (exocrine only). Adrenal glands are purely ductless endocrine glands. Pancreas is a heterocrine (mixed) gland.

Stratification layers: Emergent layer $\to$ Canopy $\to$ Understory $\to$ Forest floor. The dense overlapping tree crowns of the canopy filter out 98-99% of sunlight, leaving the forest floor in deep shade.
*Spirogyra* reproduces vegetatively by fragmentation. *Hydra* reproduces by budding. Ferns reproduce via haploid spore formation within sporangia.
